notes: Original primary full text unavailable via DOI/publisher, Unpaywall, OpenAlex, Europe PMC, institutional record and targeted open-access manuscript searches. Statistics describing the original in the replication article were not substituted for primary original evidence. Replication 2 is the corrected, no-typo attempt; main analysis uses robust standard errors (footnote 7), and includes all retained participants rather than the footnote 8 prior-participation subset. Success records the replication authors’ narrative for the assigned second attempt; the article describes the two attempts jointly as mixed.
